text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Trai-chan, analysis time. Let's figure out 
why we lost.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Mmm. Stamina consumption pace, and 
racecraft. Or is top speed itself the 
fundamental issue?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, dammit~~! There was so much more I 
could've tried~!
choice_data_list:
Let's give it our all in the next race, 
too!

If I stop, the 'unknown' will slip further 
away!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Everything I couldn't try out today, 
I'm definitely gonna nail—
choice_data_list: 次のレースで、また頑張ろう！
立ち止まったら、『未知』は遠のく！
choice_data_list_en: Let's do our best again in the next race!
If you stop now, the 'unknown' will slip away!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Why don't we show 'em what we've got?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Exactly! We have to keep running. The 
'unknown' only lies beyond that."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Alright~. I'm winning this time. Together 
with you, Trai-chan!
